_comment: Trust policy for the FDE agent runtime execution role. Attach as the role's AssumeRolePolicyDocument. The two Condition blocks are both required, not belt-and-suspenders duplicates of each other: aws:SourceAccount pins the role to THIS account (stops a runtime in a different AWS account from assuming it), and aws:SourceArn pins it to a SPECIFIC agent runtime ARN within that account (stops a different runtime in the SAME account -- e.g. a lower-trust experiment someone else deployed -- from assuming a role meant for the Engagement/Workflow/Development agent). Replace ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID} and ${AGENT_RUNTIME_ARN} at deploy time (agents/deploy/create_runtimes.py does not templatize this file automatically -- it is meant to be rendered once per runtime by your own deploy pipeline, since each of the three agents gets its own runtime ARN and, in the least-privilege case, its own role).
